title: VIMA: General Robot Manipulation with Multimodal Prompts
layout_note: Two columns rise from footer bars. The narrow left column (Multimodal Prompt) goes prompt pieces -> T5 -> a Prompt Tokens panel. The wide right column (Interaction) repeats one unit three times side by side (scene render -> object crops -> Object Encoder) feeding a single History Tokens panel, above which sits a full-width stack of alternating Cross-Attention / Self-Attention bars with a vertical dotted ellipsis between the two pairs. The branches meet only through yellow elbow lines that leave the top of Prompt Tokens, run up the gap between the columns and turn right into each Cross-Attention bar. Output action tokens sit in a row along the top edge.
grouping: Each column is named by a full-width pale footer bar along the bottom edge: mint 'Multimodal Prompt' under the left column, pale blue 'Interaction' under the right, the column width set by the bar. The prompt is held in a white rounded container with a mint outline, mixing pale-pink text pills ('Sweep all', 'into', 'without touching') with small object images. Prompt Tokens and History Tokens are both pale-yellow rounded panels with a small bold title, at the same height in the two columns. The three interaction units are separated by space only, with no boxes. A three-entry legend of token colours fills the empty top-left corner above the short prompt column. Arrow colour changes by stage: mint from prompt pieces into T5, light blue out of T5 and the Object Encoders, grey from scene objects to their crops, yellow out of the token panels, pink up through the attention stack and to the outputs.
shapes_depth: Flat throughout: no shadows, no gradients, no outlines except the mint stroke on the prompt container and coloured dashed bounding boxes on objects in the scene renders. Large-radius rounded rectangles: the attention layers are long full-width bars (Cross-Attention in saturated salmon, Self-Attention in a pale tint of the same hue), the Object Encoders are pale-blue pill-like boxes. T5 alone is a pale-blue trapezoid, wide at the bottom and narrowing upward, with a black snowflake glyph inside. Tokens are small rounded square tiles in three flat fills (orange text, lavender object, mint action) laid in a row inside their panel. Arrows are thin lines with open chevron heads; elided inputs and tokens are a grey dashed arrow plus a grey three-dot ellipsis. Scene renders are rectangular tabletop images; grey lines with rounded elbows run from each boxed object up to its cropped thumbnail. Labels are sans-serif; action labels a_1, a_2, a_3 are set in math italic.
proposed_highlight: The model is not boxed or named as one unit. The strongest fill in the figure, saturated salmon, marks the Cross-Attention bars where the prompt column's yellow lines arrive, with the paired Self-Attention bars in a lighter tint of the same hue so the stack reads as one alternating unit. The pre-trained T5 is set apart by a different shape (trapezoid) and a snowflake for frozen. Token types are made legible by the legend's three colours, reused in both token panels and the output row.
lesson: Feedback of past actions into the input is drawn without a loop-back arrow: mint action tiles labelled a_1, a_2 are interleaved in the History Tokens row, the same colour and labels as the output actions along the top.
notes: Venue year verified (arXiv comment: ICML 2023 camera-ready). Top-to-bottom the right column reads: outputs a_1 a_2 a_3 + ellipsis, Self-Attention, Cross-Attention, dotted ellipsis, Self-Attention, Cross-Attention, History Tokens, three Object Encoder units, Interaction footer. The three scene renders show the same tabletop at successive steps, with objects moved. Measurement caveat: several image boxes recorded by `refs crop` (images_px) are much larger than the visible pictures (they span the History Tokens row, the Object Encoders and part of the prompt container, likely padded embedded images), so those drawn regions are excluded from the palette and photo_share (0.348) overstates the photo area. The lavender object-token and mint action-token fills, used by the legend and both token panels, do not appear in the measured palette (small tiles, many of them inside the excluded boxes).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: two columns rising from footer bars, a narrow Multimodal Prompt column on the left and a wide Interaction column on the right, which meet only through yellow elbow lines from the Prompt Tokens panel into each Cross-Attention bar of the right-hand stack

relations.form: the right column repeats one unit three times side by side (tabletop render -> object crops -> Object Encoder) feeding a single History Tokens panel in which action tokens a1, a2 interleave with object tokens
bottom to top on the right: History Tokens -> Cross-Attention -> Self-Attention -> vertical dotted ellipsis -> Cross-Attention -> Self-Attention -> action tokens a1, a2, a3 along the top edge

the prompt is drawn as its real pieces (words 'Sweep all', 'into', 'without touching' between object images) and each scene as a rendered tabletop with dashed boxes around the detected objects whose crops sit above
two columns on their own green and blue footer bars, prompt left and interaction right

channels.colour: token colour keyed top left: orange text token, lavender object token, mint action token; red-salmon = cross-attention, pale pink = self-attention; yellow = prompt panels and the prompt-to-cross-attention lines; light blue = encoders; green/blue footers label the two columns
channels.shape: small squares are tokens, rounded bars are layers, trapezoid is the frozen T5 (snowflake), rounded boxes are object encoders
channels.line: yellow elbow lines = prompt conditioning, grey arrows = object crops to encoders, pink arrows = action outputs, dashed arrows = continuation
channels.frame: rounded tinted panels hold the token sequences; a green rounded frame holds the prompt pieces

quality.strengths: Prompt conditioning is visible as one colour of line entering every cross-attention layer from the side; real prompt pieces and real scene renders with object crops are drawn as data; tokens are coloured by type with a key; the repeated per-step unit is drawn three times identically.
quality.weaknesses: Colour carries token type, layer type and module role at once (yellow for prompt panels and the History Tokens panel too); the yellow elbow lines run long up the gap between columns; the alternating cross/self-attention stack takes the most area though it is a standard decoder.

insights.structure: Two columns with labelled footers: a narrow left 'Multimodal Prompt' column (prompt box, frozen T5 trapezoid, Prompt Tokens strip) and a wide right 'Interaction' column (three Object Encoder blocks over tabletop renders, a History Tokens strip, alternating Cross-Attention and Self-Attention bars, action outputs a1 a2 a3).
insights.data: The prompt mixes word bubbles with object images; tokens are small coloured squares (orange text, lilac object, mint action) per a top-left legend, and each timestep's observation is a rendered tabletop with dashed boxes around detected objects whose crops feed the encoder.
insights.emphasis: The cross-attention bars are the most saturated red, and yellow lines from the prompt token strip run across into each cross-attention layer, making prompt conditioning the visible link between columns.
insights.flow: Bottom to top in both columns; the prompt branch then crosses rightward into the decoder via yellow elbow arrows, and actions exit at the top while also reappearing as mint tokens in the history strip.
insights.avoid: Light grey arrows from object crops to encoders and from the history strip are faint and tangle near the scene images.

arrangement.units: two vertical columns, each named by a coloured footer bar; token strips enclosed in pale yellow rounded panels
arrangement.inputs_as: multimodal prompt (text plus object images) at bottom left; tabletop observation renders at bottom right
arrangement.shared: the object encoder is repeated per timestep
